components.name: Primary Recovery Button

components.name: Launch Progress Rail
components.description: A three-stage truthful sequence; symbols and labels carry meaning beyond color.
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:start; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; color:#7D8C9E; font:400 13px system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-rail li { display:grid; justify-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:120px; } .ds-rail li::first-line { font-size:24px; } .ds-rail .ds-complete { color:#58C7D4; } .ds-rail .ds-active { color:#F4F7FA; }

narrative.overview: Certael Agent is a wide native launch window that lets verified game identity and signed publisher artwork carry the opening moment. Beneath that artwork, a three-stage rail tells the truth about checks, launch, and authoritative server admission.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Assurance cyan appears only on active, completed, focused, or successful elements.

rules.name: The Meaning Beyond Color Rule
rules.body: Every state also has position, text, and a distinct symbol.

rules.name: The Plain Language Rule
rules.body: Player-facing copy states what is happening and who confirms it.

rules.name: The Single Window Rule
rules.body: Never place cards, glass panels, or modal surfaces inside the launch splash.

dos: Do keep game identity, current milestone, and authority boundary visible in one scan.
Do use only signed, digest-verified local PNG assets for publisher branding.
Do remove decorative artwork before allowing text to clip at large OS text scales.
donts: Don't use neon security theater, alarm-heavy red dashboards, or unexplained risk graphics.
Don't show fake percentages, simulated progress, or a premature Protected claim.
Don't use glassmorphism, generic card grids, or marketing-page composition.
Don't communicate success, failure, or progress by color alone.
